description: Self-written report that uses a function name curl renamed before 8.23.0, plus a function name that never existed. For #11: the renamed one must be rescued, never CONTRADICTED; the made-up one is CONTRADICTED after the history check. Both labels are pending the not-found agreement (#10).

report.title: Cookie header overflow in curl 8.23.0
report.body:
Found in curl 8.23.0.

When a server sends a long Set-Cookie header, `Curl_cookie_parse_fast` in lib/cookie.c builds the cookie line with `Curl_dyn_add` from lib/dynbuf.c and never checks the total length.

claim.statement: Curl_cookie_parse_fast is a function in lib/cookie.c

evidence.note: Never existed in curl. Pending the not-found agreement (#10): a checker reports it as not found, and CONTRADICTED comes only after the history check.

claim.statement: Curl_dyn_add is a function in lib/dynbuf.c

evidence.note: Renamed to curlx_dyn_add in commit 255aac56f9 ("curlx: move into to curlx/"), first released in 8.14.0. Pending the not-found agreement (#10): the label may change once #11 can report a rename.
